subject: Interim credit request for transient seats + VAT evidence and collection hold
messages:
From: Finance Team <finance@heliox.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle seat charge on invoice #20260315 — request for interim credit and VAT docs

Hi Irene,

We noticed an unexpected charge on invoice #20260315 for 7 transient seats that were enabled briefly for load testing on 2026-03-12. The total mid-cycle line item is $2,340 and it posted to our card this morning. Can you help with:

- A provisional credit (or reverse charge) while we reconcile the usage?
- A breakdown of the prorated calculation used so we can reconcile against our internal ledger
- Evidence for VAT handling: we are an EU entity and need documentation that the charge is VAT-exempt / reverse-charged where applicable

We attached a screenshot of the billing line. We would prefer a credit memo rather than a refund to keep our accounting clean. Also please pause any collections on this invoice until the credit is issued — our AP team will not escalate to collections if a credit is in process.

PO (if needed) and contact: Olivia Park, finance@heliox.com, PO #4932 (attached).

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Finance — Heliox Systems

Attachments: screenshot_charge.png (image)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Finance Team <finance@heliox.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle seat charge on invoice #20260315 — request for interim credit and VAT docs

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and for sending the PO. Apologies for the surprise charge. I pulled the transaction and have looped in Billing (Marissa) and Collections (Ben) so we can coordinate the credit and hold. Next steps I propose:

1) We will issue a provisional credit memo against invoice #20260315 for the prorated 7 seats and route it as a credit memo (no refund) per your preference.
2) Billing will attach a short calculation and the credit memo PDF for your records.
3) Collections: we will place a temporary hold on collections for this invoice until 2026-04-06 to allow for reconciliation. If you need a longer hold, let us know.
4) VAT: please confirm Heliox VAT ID and entity registration country (you mentioned EU) — once we have that we can mark the credit memo appropriately and include the reverse-charge reference where applicable.

I prepared a draft provisional credit note to speed things up — attaching now. Marissa, Ben: can you review the draft and the calculation below and confirm we can issue in the current cycle?

Quick provisional calc (high-level):
- Monthly committed seats: 120
- Transient seats billed: 7 for 3 days (2026-03-12 to 2026-03-15)
- Unit seat price (monthly): $160
- Prorated amount = 7 * $160 * (3/31) = $1,088.39 (Rounded on invoice to $1,088.00)

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

Thanks Irene — I reviewed the draft and reconciled the usage logs. A few clarifying notes for accounting and tax treatment: 

- Calculation detail (attached spreadsheet) shows the day-by-day seat activation and confirms the 3-day window. We use 31 days for March proration.
- The rounding on the invoice is applied at line-item level, so final credit memo may differ by a few cents.
- For VAT: if Heliox is EU-registered and provides a valid VAT ID, we will issue the credit memo with reverse-charge language (no VAT charged by Redwood). If no VAT ID, we will reissue with VAT applied per standard EU rules.
- Collections: Ben, please place the collections hold on BILL-20260315 and mark as 'credit pending'. We will target credit issuance by 2026-04-02 so that it posts in the same billing run.

Ben, I've attached the proration_calc.xlsx used to derive the $1,088.39 pre-round. Please confirm when the hold is in place.

Marissa Cole
